title: I had a feeling they would get good guests for NYC but wow I was NOT ...
transcript: This was insane. I can't believe I just watched John Oliver and Seth Meyers play taskmaster. If you don't know the UK show, taskmaster is currently finishing up a US tour where they are bringing a live episode of the taskmaster show hosted by Greg and Alex to multiple cities in the US. They did one in Chicago, Boston, Washington D C, Philadelphia, and now they are doing two nights in New York. Each show has five contestants, three audience members, and two special guests. And tonight one in New York. Really lucked out because we got John Oliver and South Myers. They were both just as funny as you would expect. John was incredibly competitive, like, you could tell he wanted to win so badly, and Seth was just there to have a good time. And they basically played out a full episode of taskmaster down to Greg and Alex doing their little intro banter. They did a prize task, and then all of the other tasks were recreation of live tasks that they've done on the show. There was one funny task where they had to put a grape in their mouth or hand, and then Greg had to guess where the grape was. They each had to answer one question, and Seth's question was, of all the other late night hosts, fuck, marry, kill. He did decline to answer it and instead just took the grape out of his mouth and threw it into the audience. There was another Task where they had to draw a portrait upside down based on Greg's description and John's was horrific. And then for the final task, we had Jason Mantzoukas show up, and the contestants had to guess a surprising title that he held in the past. If you are wondering, he was the president of his high school marching band, a fact which surprised Seth Meyers, his longtime friend. We also had a cameo from Tom Cashman, aka lesser Tom, earlier in the show. Even ended in a tie, which meant that they had to go to a tiebreaker task. A classic game of horse or laminator. And in the end, John was victorious and won a little mini Greg trophy. This was truly so much fun, and I think makes the case even stronger that we need an American version of taskmaster. But at the very least, I hope that this becomes a regular thing, because I would go to a million of these.
